text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 53, September 09, 1936 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 8, CURRENT SERIES, BY PROVIDING A NEW TIME LIMIT
FOR CIVIL SERVICE QUALIFICATION FOR EMPLOYEES THEREIN MENTIONED
WHEREAS, the National Assembly has by resolution adopted August tenth, nineteen hundred and thirty-six.
“Resolved, That it is the sense of the National Assembly that those employees of the Government who are
now in the unclassified list and are required by Executive Order Numbered Eight to qualify in the Civil
Service within one year from the first examination to be held, should be given another year, during which to
qualify, after the expiration of the one-year period provided for in said Executive Order; and that, during the
period provided herein, and in Executive Order Numbered Eight, the employees concerned shall be given an
opportunity to take the examinations three times,”
